executive_summary: The video discusses the Eastern Air crash data released by the US, revealing the truth about the accident. The NTSB and China Civil Aviation Administration data show that the co-pilot intentionally caused the crash, resulting in 131 fatalities.

key_facts: The US NTSB released data on the Eastern Air crash.
The co-pilot intentionally caused the crash.
The China Civil Aviation Administration is involved in the investigation.
forward_implications: The incident may lead to changes in aviation safety policies.
The reputation of the airlines and aviation industry may be affected.
There may be financial implications for the airlines and related companies.
